text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober trembles with joy after 
giving it her all in the big race. Back in 
the waiting room, she expresses her 
gratitude to everyone who supported her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After her Debut race, word began to spread 
swiftly throughout the public, praising 
Mejiro Dober as the Mejiro family's new 
rising hope—
